import hashlib,hmac,json,urllib.parse
uri=urllib.parse.quote('/bucket/ZZZZZZZZ key/雪',safe='/-_.~')
items=[('z','ZZZZZZZZ'),('a','雪'),('a','a/b c')]
enc=lambda s:urllib.parse.quote(s,safe='-_.~')
query='&'.join(k+'='+v for k,v in sorted((enc(k),enc(v)) for k,v in items))
empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest()
headers='host:example.test\nx-amz-content-sha256:'+empty+'\nx-amz-date:20261020T120000Z\nx-zzzzzzzz:private value 雪\n'
names='host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date;x-zzzzzzzz'
canonical='\n'.join(['GET',uri,query,headers,names,empty])
scope='20261020/us-east-1/s3/aws4_request'
string='AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n20261020T120000Z\n'+scope+'\n'+hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()
k=b'AWS4public signing fixture'
for part in ['20261020','us-east-1','s3','aws4_request']:k=hmac.new(k,part.encode(),hashlib.sha256).digest()
signature=hmac.new(k,string.encode(),hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps(dict(uri=uri,query=query,canonical_request=canonical,string_to_sign=string,signed_headers=names,signature=signature,authorization='AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=PUBLIC/'+scope+', SignedHeaders='+names+', Signature='+signature),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
